title: Validation Of anatomY-specific Aortic Valve Implantation Guided by Software Using EncantoR
official: VOYAGER CE Clinical Trial : Validation Of anatomY-specific Aortic Valve Implantation Guided by Software Using EncantoR
summary: VOYAGER CE Clinical Study using the Encantor TAVI System.
conditions: Symptomatic Heart Disease Due to Severe Native Calcific Aortic Stenosis
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subject identified as appropriate for transcatheter heart valve intervention therapy for the treatment of symptomatic, severe aortic stenosis.
* Subject is of legal age for consent (18 years old).
* Willing to return for required follow-up visits and assessments

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant or nursing subjects.
* Need for emergency surgery for any reason
* Anatomic or comorbid conditions
* Currently participating in an investigational drug or device study that has not reached the primary endpoint or may confound the results of this trial

sites.f: Hospital Alvaro Cunqueiro, Dept of Interventional Cardiology
